name: barbell butterfly z press
description: A seated floor press overhead with a barbell and a wide hand position. It builds strong shoulders with a stable trunk.
instructions: Sit on the floor with legs out in front and the bar at upper-chest height.
Take a wide grip and brace your abs.
Press the bar overhead until your arms are straight.
Lower it back to your upper chest under control.
Keep your back tall and avoid arching.
Use a light weight at first.
